narrative.introduction: The Fruit Ontology catalogs canonical culinary fruits, berries, citrus, melons, and fruit-derived ingredients used worldwide in cooking. This domain models culinary ingredients, not horticulture, beverages, or prepared foods.
narrative.seo_description: Explore canonical culinary fruits and berries by group — usage intensity, identity, and pairing metadata in the PairingMethod Food Ontology.
narrative.summary: Canonical culinary fruits across seven immutable groups: Pomes, Stone Fruits, Citrus, Berries, Tropical Fruits, Melons, and Processed Fruits.
